matchup_of_the_week.blurb: Well, Aidan is back on prime time this week. This just has to be the Matchup of the Week for Week 4, as we see the 2nd and 3rd ranked teams go head to head in what’s projected to be a shootout. This matchup is dead even, 3-3, all-time. I expect this to be the best Matchup of the Week yet and maybe even an early season playoff preview. I think Baylen is likely to take the win here and knock Aidan down to 1-3, but don’t be surprised if Aidan pulls off the win.

teams.synopsis: Think about it for a second, there’s maybe one player I’d rather have than Jahmyr Gibbs right now, Chuba Hubbard looks like a high-end RB2 once again, Drake London just needed a semi-decent quarterback, George Pickens is in store for a monster Week 4, and as I’ve said in weeks prior, this team is so deep that the FLEX may change from week-to-week and still give you 15+ points.
teams.blurb: I think this team just has to reclaim the throne at the top of the rankings despite not having the most points scored in the league. Charlie’s team bounced back in Week 3 after a worrisome Week 2 performance, and I think we’ll see much more of that team in the weeks to come, hence the top ranking. Think about it for a second, there’s maybe one player I’d rather have than Jahmyr Gibbs right now, Chuba Hubbard looks like a high-end RB2 once again, Drake London just needed a semi-decent quarterback, George Pickens is in store for a monster Week 4, and as I’ve said in weeks prior, this team is so deep that the FLEX may change from week-to-week and still give you 15+ points. As interconference play kicks off this week, I’m looking forward to Charlie giving some of my conference mates losses in the next few weeks.

teams.synopsis: This team simply has an incredible design with very few flaws, at least in the context of a 14-man league.
teams.blurb: I don’t know what it is, but SheLoveQuigs just gives me the chills. Back-to-back 130+ point weeks for penultimate team in the Week 4 Rankings, Aidan is once again on primetime for what projects to be a shootout with Station Grits. Aidan is 3rd in the league in points per week, despite not having the record to show for it, so 2026 could get annoying fast if the team once again scores at the top of the league just to lose. I could go over how I love the depth this team has, or how the WR duo is probably the best in Preach League this season, or how the running backs are exactly what you want from where you drafted them. This team simply has an incredible design with very few flaws, at least in the context of a 14-man league. Week 4 will most definitely be a tough one for the team, but I expect them to have a good 2026 campaign.

teams.synopsis: After a 167.94-point performance in Week 3, Baylen becomes the top team in points per week through three weeks, and once again it was led by his two stars, Jaxon Smith-Njigba and Brock Purdy, the WR1 and QB2 through Week 3 respectively.
teams.blurb: What a Week 3 from Station Grits. After a 167.94-point performance in Week 3, Baylen becomes the top team in points per week through three weeks, and once again it was led by his two stars, Jaxon Smith-Njigba and Brock Purdy, the WR1 and QB2 through Week 3 respectively. The team has increased their point output by around 30 points each week so far, which I don’t expect to continue, but I wouldn’t be surprised if the team once again finds a way to pace the league in scoring for Week 4. The double TE strategy is doing wonders, while Michael Wilson and Luther Burden are plenty for the WR2 spot behind Jaxon Smith-Njigba. Once again, the running backs are the only real issue on the roster, but if they can continue to combine for 25+ point weeks then I bet Baylen will be more than satisfied. It will be a tough matchup against a top ranked opponent in Week 4, basically a battle to see who will be ranked higher in next week’s rankings.

teams.synopsis: Unlike the other three teams that I have ranked above Anthony, this team has scored less and less points each week, not the type of trend you want to be on.
teams.blurb: The top four teams are pretty obvious at this point. Only four teams average over 120 points a week, with Rolls With Butter being at the bottom of the tier. But unlike the other three teams that I have ranked above Anthony, this team has scored less and less points each week, not the type of trend you want to be on. Still, the team is 2-1 and they get the easiest matchup in the league in Week 4. So, I expect this team to continue to win and start the season off hot. However, the hardest projected strength of schedule may make things interesting as we go beyond Week 4. A top team in 2026, but can they climb even higher? We shall see.

teams.synopsis: Sure, the team is 1-2 right now, but they have increased production each and every week this season.
teams.blurb: Sure, the team is 1-2 right now, but they have increased production each and every week this season. After being ranked 14th in the Week 2 rankings, Ryan has climbed his way into the top five after a couple weeks, and with the easiest projected strength of schedule rest of season, I don’t see why the team can’t stay up here in the rankings for the remainder of the season. The team may have some issues at running back once Jordan Mason gets off Injury Reserve in a couple weeks, but for now I’d just ride the Aaron Jones Sr. wave. The team as constructed doesn’t scream league winner or title favorite, but they’ll be in the running for the 2026 playoffs and that’s really all you need.

teams.synopsis: Losing De’Von Achane for season and Justin Jefferson for a week or two is just brutal for a team that was primed to have a career-best season.
teams.blurb: Let’s simplify this, losing De’Von Achane for season and Justin Jefferson for a week or two is just brutal for a team that was primed to have a career-best season. N.Y. Routensss goes from a team that is feared on a weekly basis to now a team that people are optimistic to play. However, I think the trade Andrew made to replenish his RB room was great and will keep him fighting for middle playoff seeding. Looking at the ESPN matchup rankings for Andrew’s players in Week 4, I can see a lot of green, so maybe we get a major bounce back performance from the team. I’m hopeful that the team can get back to the playoffs after missing it the past couple of seasons, but with the new look starting lineup we’ll have to wait and see if they’re capable of doing so. That 2nd easiest projected strength of schedule should be helpful to the cause.

teams.synopsis: After Deebo Samuel’s 15.4-point performance in Week 3 he has now moved into the top five on Ben’s all-time scoring list, only three points away from cracking the 300-point mark.
teams.blurb: Like the team above, Ben just feels like a middling team in 2026. The team has scored fewer points each week through three weeks, and with Travis Etienne Jr. now on Injury Reserve it may get dicey for the team. On the bright side, the matchup in Week 4 doesn’t appear to be that daunting, while some of the players on Ben’s roster, like CeeDee Lamb, appear to be in store for a big Week 4. In other news, after Deebo Samuel’s 15.4-point performance in Week 3 he has now moved into the top five on Ben’s all-time scoring list, only three points away from cracking the 300-point mark.

teams.synopsis: So far, 2026 has been the franchise’s weakest season since 2020.
teams.blurb: With a sub-100-point performance in Week 3, The Minutemen now sit as the middle of the road team in terms of points per week. A big trade after Week 3 saw Brandon deal Kyren Williams, his RB2, for some much-needed help at WR and TE. The WR help may not be available in Week 4 though, since Jalen Coker is dealing with an injury. Week 4 will not be pretty, but a win is all that will matter. So far, 2026 has been the franchise’s weakest season since 2020. The team already has two wins, but if they want to get back into the playoffs this season they will have to pick it up and have some boom weeks.

teams.synopsis: Historically, the franchise has had tremendous success in Week 4, winning four of their six matchups and putting up over 122 points in five of their six matchups.
teams.blurb: Despite being only one of three teams to average less than 100 points per week, I have Carmine rising to 9th in the Week 4 rankings. The team will be without Breece Hall for some time, but Nico Collins appears to be a full-go for Week 4. The RB2 slot may get scary this week with Rachaad White now being listed as out, so let’s keep an eye on that. The team has disappointed so far, but they had a solid Week 3 performance and honestly with Bijan Robinson in your lineup you’ll have a fighting chance most weeks. Historically, the franchise has had tremendous success in Week 4, winning four of their six matchups and putting up over 122 points in five of their six matchups. For now, this ranking is much more forward thinking, but if the team continues to be subpar then maybe they will drop back down.

teams.synopsis: I believe the team picks up its second win of the season in Week 4 and moves to 2-2, the potential 4th time in franchise history that the team starts that well through four weeks.
teams.blurb: Week 3 was not pretty for this team, it was actually the franchise’s worst Week 3 in league history, I see the vision for a bounce back in Week 4, however. The RB room was this team’s biggest question mark a couple weeks ago, but now? Well, now Bucky Irving looks like a borderline RB1 and gets a juicy matchup in Week 4, while Alvin Kamara slides into the RB1 spot for the Saints after Travis Etienne Jr. was placed on Injury Reserve. Combine that with Dak Prescott getting a nice matchup, Amon-Ra St. Brown projected to be in a shootout once again with no Jaycee Horn for the Panthers, and Trey McBride being Mr. Consistent and you got yourself what looks to be a boom week for Leased to Jetty. I believe the team picks up its second win of the season in Week 4 and moves to 2-2, the potential 4th time in franchise history that the team starts that well through four weeks.

teams.synopsis: Jeremiyah Love looks like he has arrived, Josh Downs is primed for a contract year breakout, the Jayden Daniels injury looks much better than initial reports claimed, and that Puka Nacua lifeline looks like it has arrived.
teams.blurb: On the rise after getting their first win of the season in Week 3. The team doesn’t look incredible by any means, but there’s a few things that give me optimism for the team’s future. Jeremiyah Love looks like he has arrived, Josh Downs is primed for a contract year breakout, the Jayden Daniels injury looks much better than initial reports claimed, and that Puka Nacua lifeline looks like it has arrived. Yes, TreVeyon Henderson and Ladd McConkey may not be what Cole wants them to be, but that’s alright for now. According to ESPN projections, Cole’s Week 4 matchup looks to be a difficult one, but that’s what we said last week and look at what happened. I’m also hearing rumors of this team being active in the trade market, let’s see if anything happens between now and kickoff on Sunday.

teams.synopsis: Omarion Hampton looks like one of the biggest 1st round busts we’ve seen in Preach League history based on surplus value, his current surplus value would rank 92nd out of 97 eligible first round picks since 2020.
teams.blurb: As you can tell with this ranking, I’m not happy with my team. Like Max, this team had a solid Week 1, but the Week 2 and Week 3 performances were the worst performances for those weeks in franchise history. Despite the win in Week 3, there was little to be happy about since the D/ST and Kicker combined for about 30% of the team’s production, and that’s not very sticky week-to-week. Omarion Hampton looks like one of the biggest 1st round busts we’ve seen in Preach League history based on surplus value, his current surplus value would rank 92nd out of 97 eligible first round picks since 2020. There are a couple bright spots on the roster, including Parker Washington, Ashton Jeanty, and Zay Flowers, but it’s going to take more than those three to be a playoff team once again for the 7th year in a row.

teams.synopsis: After a solid Week 1 performance Max’s team has had its worst Week 2 and Week 3 performances in league history.
teams.blurb: Staying at 13th for the second week in a row, after a solid Week 1 performance Max’s team has had its worst Week 2 and Week 3 performances in league history. Still, I think this team is due for a bounce back in Week 4, even if that doesn’t lead to a win against what’s projected to be a tough matchup. Derrick Henry, Matthew Golden, and Tee Higgins have been doing their jobs, but the rest of team has yet to show up consistently, if at all. This week could be different though, with no Devonta Smith the Eagles should lean on their star running back to get the job done against the Rams, and I believe Bryce Young is in store for a big performance in Week 4, I’m thinking 25+ points from him. Max is 1-2 and with the second fewest points per game things could get grim fast, but let’s see if the team gets back on track in interconference play.

teams.synopsis: Even with a win under his belt, I’d say Quin is the early season favorite to finish as this year’s last place team.
teams.blurb: It’s been a rough start to the 2026 fantasy season for Quin. He starts off this season at 1-2, which is the 6th time in seven years that he’s started off 1-2 or worse, so nothing new for the franchise. The team is at the bottom of the league in points per game, only one of three managers to average less than 100 points per week through the first three weeks. Quin averages 90.1 points per week. The reason for this sad start? The Chargers’ offense has been abysmal, making Justin Herbert and Quentin Johnston unplayable, Malik Nabers has looked unlike himself to start the year, maybe the ACL effects are lingering, or the shoulder injury matters more than we think. Chase Brown has also started slow, something his 2025 managers know all too well about. Devonta Smith and maybe Isaiah Likely are the only players on this team that I think Quin should be happy about so far. Even with a win under his belt, I’d say Quin is the early season favorite to finish as this year’s last place team.
